question:
​Simplify the following:

(1)/(tan²theta) + (tan²theta)/(sin²theta) times cos²theta
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put θ = 30° in the given expression.

tan 30° = 1/√3, sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2

Expression = 1/(1/3) + [ (1/3) ÷ (1/4) ] × (3/4) = 3 + (4/3) × (3/4) = 3 + 1 = 4

Checking the options for θ = 30°:

Option 3: cosec² 30° = (2)² = 4 (Matches perfectly)

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

1/tan²θ + (tan²θ / sin²θ) × cos²θ

**Formulas Used:**

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ

cot θ = 1 / tan θ

1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1/tan²θ + [ (sin²θ / cos²θ) / sin²θ ] × cos²θ

⇒ cot²θ + (1 / cos²θ) × cos²θ

⇒ cot²θ + 1

⇒ cosec²θ

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental relations between trigonometric functions: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

Reciprocal Identities

The reciprocal of basic ratios: cosec θ = 1 / sin θ | sec θ = 1 / cos θ | cot θ = 1 / tan θ

Quotient Identities

Expressing tangent and cotangent in terms of sine and cosine: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ | cot θ = cos θ / sin θ
